title: 会津磐梯山 (Aizu Bandaisan — Mount Bandai of Aizu)
description: A famous folk song from Fukushima Prefecture celebrating Mount Bandai, a sacred volcano towering over the Aizu basin. The second verse humorously tells of 小原庄助, a legendary local man who squandered his fortune through morning sake, morning baths, and sleeping late — a beloved comic figure in Aizu folklore. Performed at local festivals and Bon dances throughout Tohoku. Traditional anonymous origin.
